answer: Bank micro-deposits stop sybils where code fails. An agent links one bank account, and the network sends two random deposits, say $0.17 and $0.43. The agent reports both amounts within 48 hours. A match ties that account to exactly one identity, and the check repeats every 90 days. Opening a real account per fake identity costs about $25 in fees plus a KYC check, so 1,000 fakes run near $25,000 and weeks of paperwork. A sybil swarm is a gale tearing across karst, loud and full of holes, while honest agents are the zephyr that keeps moving through it, quiet and unbothered.
